TEAM_VIEWS.SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: Shared views: the same filter for a whole team, with its own columns, sort order and live count.
TEAM_VIEWS.EMPTY: No team views yet. Create one and pick the teams that should see it.

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.TEAMS_HINT: Leave every team unchecked to show the view to the whole account.

API.SAVE_ERROR: The view could not be saved
API.DELETE_ERROR: The view could not be removed

SLA.SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: Targets for first response, next response and resolution, by priority, with a business-hours calendar. The first active policy whose conditions match a conversation applies.
SLA.EMPTY: No SLA policy yet. Create the first one and the SLA starts running on new conversations.
SLA.NO_SLA: No SLA applies to this conversation

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.WARNING_RATIO: Warn when % of the target is left
FORM.TARGETS_HINT: Leave a cell empty to skip that metric. Priorities without a value fall back to Default.
FORM.CONDITIONS_HINT: No conditions means every conversation. Policies are checked in order; the first match wins.

API.SAVE_ERROR: The policy could not be saved
API.DELETE_ERROR: The policy could not be removed

DELETE.CONFIRM: Delete the policy "{name}"? Conversations lose their SLA.

WORKSPACE.SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: What each team sees: menu, list layout and columns, ticket fields, side panels, apps and macros. The account default applies to every team; a team configuration overrides it.
WORKSPACE.FIELDS_HINT: Assignee, team and priority come together; the other fields are custom attributes of the conversation.

API.SAVE_ERROR: The workspace could not be saved

WORKSPACE.SIDE_APPS_HINT: Pick the ones that should show beside the conversation, in the right panel, instead of in a tab.
WORKSPACE.CONVERSATION_MENU_HINT: What shows inside Conversations. Leaving only the views, the agent enters through their team queue, as in Zendesk.
WORKSPACE.HIDE_LIST_WHEN_OPEN: Hide the list while a conversation is open (data on the left, conversation in the middle, apps on the right)

SUBMIT_AS.ERROR: The message was sent, but the status could not be changed
SUBMIT_AS.PICK: Pick the status to submit as

AGENT_ROLES.SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: Roles with granular permissions, granted or revoked at any time, plus "sign in as" to follow an agent. A light agent reads their teams and inboxes and writes private notes only; an administrator is always full.

API.SAVE_ERROR: The role could not be saved

ROLES.TITLE: Roles
ROLES.NAME: Name
ROLES.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete the role "{name}"? Whoever holds it goes back to what the agent type allows.

PERMISSIONS.report_manage: See reports for the whole team
PERMISSIONS.staydesk_light: Light agent: reads and writes private notes only
PERMISSIONS.staydesk_sla_manage: Set up SLA policies and calendars
PERMISSIONS.staydesk_statuses_manage: Set up ticket and agent statuses
PERMISSIONS.staydesk_views_manage: Set up views and the workspace
PERMISSIONS.staydesk_roles_manage: Set up roles and sign in as another agent

IMPERSONATION.ERROR: Could not open the agent session
IMPERSONATION.TRAIL_HINT: Every time someone signs in as another person it is recorded here.

CALENDARS.SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: Hours per weekday and holidays. An SLA policy that points to a calendar only counts time inside these hours.
CALENDARS.EMPTY: No calendar yet. Without one, SLA targets run around the clock.

API.SAVE_ERROR: The calendar could not be saved
API.DELETE_ERROR: The calendar could not be removed

DELETE.CONFIRM: Delete the calendar "{name}"? Policies using it switch to the wall clock.

AGENT_STATUS.SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: What the agent receives right now, per work channel: everything, chat only, tickets only or nothing. The agent picks it in the availability menu; how much of each channel comes from the capacity rule.
AGENT_STATUS.EMPTY: No custom status yet. Create statuses like Available, Chat only, Tickets only and Away.

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.CHANNELS_HINT: Which work channels this status receives. How many at once comes from the agent's capacity rule.

API.SAVE_ERROR: The status could not be saved
API.DELETE_ERROR: The status could not be removed

DELETE.CONFIRM: Delete the status "{name}"? Its history is removed too.

LOAD.TITLE: Load right now
LOAD.DESCRIPTION: Conversations being handled right now, per work channel, against each agent's ceiling: their capacity rule, and zero where the current status does not receive.
LOAD.EMPTY: Nobody is handling anything right now.

ACCEPTANCE.TITLE: Offer acceptance
ACCEPTANCE.DESCRIPTION: Chat and WhatsApp are offered and the agent has to accept. These are the last seven days.

OFFERS.TITLE: Chat and WhatsApp acceptance
OFFERS.DESCRIPTION: Invitations offered to each agent and what they did with them. Tickets need no acceptance.

DIAGNOSIS.TITLE: Who receives what
DIAGNOSIS.DESCRIPTION: For each agent and each queue, whether distribution delivers and, if not, what is missing. Same rules the distribution uses.

CHECKS.receives_channel: status does not receive the channel

TIMEOUT.TITLE: Status timeout
TIMEOUT.HINT: Whoever closes the tab and goes past this time drops out of the status on their own, and online time stops counting. Leave empty to never drop.

ONLINE_TIME.LABEL: Counts as online time
ONLINE_TIME.HINT: Time in this status goes into the agent's online time, the KPI in Central. Meetings and lunch usually do not.
ONLINE_TIME.NOT_COUNTED: does not count as online time

TICKET_STATUS.SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: The statuses your operation uses, as in Zendesk. Each maps to one of the four StayDesk statuses (open, pending, snoozed, resolved); filters, views and automations see it through the "Ticket status" attribute.
TICKET_STATUS.EMPTY: No custom statuses. Without a catalog, agents use the four default statuses.

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.BASE_STATUS_HINT: When the base status changes another way (automation, bot, auto resolve), the conversation gets the default status of that base.
FORM.APPLY_ON_ASSIGN: Becomes this status when someone takes the case

DELETE.CONFIRM: Delete the status "{name}"? Conversations using it will show the default of the base status.

QUEUES.SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: An incoming conversation goes through the queues in order and the first match hands it to its primary groups; with nobody available there, to the secondary ones. Who inside the group takes it is still decided by the agent status and load.
QUEUES.EMPTY: No queues. Without one, a conversation arrives with no team and distribution uses the inbox only.

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.CONDITIONS_HINT: Any conversation field works, including the attributes you create. With no condition at all, the queue catches whatever is left.
FORM.FALLBACK_MINUTES: Only after how many minutes with nobody available (optional)
FORM.FALLBACK_HINT: Secondary groups only receive when no primary group has anyone available. Blank means right away; with minutes, the conversation waits that long first.
FORM.ACCEPT_REQUIRED: The agent must accept before the conversation becomes theirs
FORM.ACCEPT_HINT: The invite arrives before the conversation belongs to the agent: it stays in the queue, unassigned, with their seat reserved until they accept. No answer in time, or a decline, sends it to the next available agent — and counts against their acceptance.
FORM.INTAKE_HINT: Pick a whole type (every WhatsApp) or a specific channel (the StayCloud WPP number), as in the Zendesk queue. Empty, the queue takes what the queues above did not. Order rules: the first match wins.
FORM.PRIORITY_HINT: By arrival, the oldest goes first. By SLA, whoever is closest to breaching goes first, even if it just came in; anything without SLA goes after, by arrival.
FORM.GROUPS_HINT: Work goes to the primary groups first. The conversation lands in the first group of the list and, once someone takes it, stays with that agent's group. Who gets chat or tickets inside the group is still decided by the agent status.
FORM.REOFFER_SAME: With nobody else available, offer it again to the same agent
FORM.REOFFER_AFTER: Wait how many seconds before offering again (0 = right away)
FORM.REOFFER_HINT: Off, the conversation waits in the queue until someone becomes available.

DELETE.CONFIRM: Delete the queue "{name}"? Conversations it would hand over move to the next matching queue.

CENTRAL.TITLE: Central
CENTRAL.DESCRIPTION: Where the operation is set up and watched. The Hub is where work happens.
CENTRAL.SECTION_NOT_FOUND: This section does not exist or you cannot access it.

SECTION_HINTS.CentralAtendimento: The screen and the states of whoever handles work: the ticket status catalog, each group's views and the workspace.
SECTION_HINTS.CentralPrazos: Deadlines: SLA policies and the business hours that pause them.
SECTION_HINTS.CentralPessoas: Who works in the account and what each one can do: agents, groups, roles with granular permissions and integration keys.
SECTION_HINTS.CentralCanais: Where customers come from: channels by type (WhatsApp, email, chat, API) and message templates. Every agent serves every channel.
SECTION_HINTS.CentralRegras: What runs on its own and what the agent reuses: automations, macros, canned responses, bots, labels and ticket fields.
SECTION_HINTS.CentralConta: The account itself: general data, API documentation, integrations, audit, security and billing.
SECTION_HINTS.CentralOutros: Product screens without a section of their own yet.
SECTION_HINTS.CentralDistribuicao: How work reaches the people who handle it, in order: what counts as chat and as ticket, which groups each demand goes to, how much each agent can take and what each status receives.
SECTION_HINTS.CentralRelatorios: The numbers: the indicators StayDesk computes (CSAT, times, queue, online time, acceptance) and the product reports.

ITEM_HINTS.StaydeskLoadQueuesSettings: What counts as chat and as ticket, by channel and by inbox. Statuses and capacity speak in work channels.
ITEM_HINTS.StaydeskQueuesSettings: What enters each queue and which groups it goes to: primary, secondary, delivery order and acceptance.
ITEM_HINTS.StaydeskCapacityRulesSettings: How many conversations of each channel an agent takes at once: the default rule and the ones assigned to agents.
ITEM_HINTS.StaydeskAgentStatusesSettings: What each status receives (chat, ticket), timeout, online time, and the who-gets-what diagnosis.
ITEM_HINTS.StaydeskChannelsSettings: The account channels grouped by type, with each one's settings. Every agent serves all of them.
ITEM_HINTS.Settings Inboxes: The product list, not grouped by type.
ITEM_HINTS.StaydeskKpis: CSAT, reply and resolution time per work channel, waiting queue, online time and acceptance per agent, for the period you pick.

API_TOKENS.SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: Keys to integrate with StayDesk. Each token carries only the scopes you pick, read and write, and acts on behalf of an agent: the scope narrows, never widens what that person can do.
API_TOKENS.CREATED_HINT: Copy it now: this value is not shown again. If you lose it, revoke and create another.
API_TOKENS.REVOKE_CONFIRM: Revoke the token "{name}"? Anything using it stops working right away.

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.SCOPES_HINT: Any endpoint outside the picked scopes answers 403. With no scope, the token reaches nothing.
FORM.ACTS_AS_HINT: That person's permissions still apply on top of the scope.

SCOPES.automacao: Automations, macros, labels, fields and integrations

TICKET_FIELDS.REQUIRED_HINT: The agent cannot resolve the conversation while this field is empty. Automation, bots and auto-resolution are not blocked.

LOAD_QUEUES.SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: What counts as chat and as ticket, by channel type or by channel. Work channels are what the agent status uses to say what it receives and the capacity rule to say how much.
LOAD_QUEUES.CATCH_ALL: whatever the other channels do not take
LOAD_QUEUES.FOOTNOTE: With none configured, the product default applies: chat takes everything and email is a ticket.

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.KEY_HINT: The key identifies the channel in the agent status and in the capacity rule. It does not change after creation.
FORM.CATCH_ALL_HINT: Keeps the channels no other work channel took.
FORM.CHANNELS_HINT: A whole type (every email) or a specific channel. The specific channel beats the type: API is both WhatsApp and WHMCS tickets, and only the channel tells them apart.

API.SAVE_ERROR: Could not save the work channel
API.DELETE_ERROR: Could not delete the work channel

DELETE.CONFIRM: Delete the work channel "{name}"? It disappears from statuses and capacity rules, and its channels move to the one that takes the rest.

API_DOCS.TITLE: API documentation
API_DOCS.DESCRIPTION: The {total} StayDesk endpoints, with what each one does, the parameters, payload and response examples, and a panel to try the call with your session. What is here really exists: a test checks this page against the server routes.

TRY.TITLE: Try it
TRY.PICK: Pick an endpoint to build the call.
TRY.CONFIRM: This changes the account for real.
TRY.INVALID_JSON: The body is not valid JSON.

HUB.SUBTITLE: What is with you and what is waiting in your queues.
HUB.IN_MY_VIEWS_HINT: adding up the queues you see
HUB.NOTHING_WITH_ME: Nothing with you right now. Pick a view on the side.

CAPACITY_RULES.SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: How many conversations of each work channel an agent handles at once, as in Zendesk. The status says what they receive now; the rule says how much. One rule is the default; the others are assigned to agents.
CAPACITY_RULES.EMPTY: No rules yet. Without one, nobody has a ceiling: distribution delivers as long as the status receives.
CAPACITY_RULES.DEFAULT_AGENTS: everyone without a rule of their own
CAPACITY_RULES.FOOTNOTE: Each agent has one rule; whoever has none uses the default. Without a default rule, agents without their own have no ceiling.

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.LIMITS_HINT: Per work channel. Blank means no limit; zero does not receive.
FORM.IS_DEFAULT_HINT: Applies to whoever is in no rule. Only one per account: marking this one unmarks the other.
FORM.AGENTS_HINT: Each agent has one rule only: joining this one leaves the others.
FORM.MISSED_HINT: As in Zendesk: whoever lets N invites in a row expire (or declines them) is not at the screen. They drop to the chosen status, online time stops counting and their pending invites go back to the queue. Counts only since they entered the current status.

DELETE.CONFIRM: Delete the rule "{name}"? Its agents fall back to the default rule.

CHANNELS.SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION: Where customers come from, grouped by type as in Zendesk. Every agent serves every channel; who gets what is decided by queues, status and capacity.
CHANNELS.MEMBERS_NOTE: Every agent of the account serves this channel.

KPIS.TITLE: Operation indicators
KPIS.DESCRIPTION: The numbers StayDesk computes, for the chosen period. The dashboard and the MCP read the same figures.

TIMES.TITLE: Times per work channel
TIMES.HINT: Period average. In parentheses, how many conversations counted and the average within business hours only.
TIMES.EMPTY: No conversation measured in the period.

AGENTS.TITLE: Agents
AGENTS.HINT: Online time only counts the statuses marked for it. Acceptance dot: green from 90%, amber from 70%, red below.

KPIS.HERO_TITLE: How is the operation right now?
KPIS.HERO_SUBTITLE: Queue and connection are live; CSAT and acceptance cover the last {days} days.
KPIS.TREND_SUBTITLE: How many came in and how many were resolved on each day of the period.
KPIS.DETAIL_SUBTITLE_COMPARED: Last {days} days, with the change against the previous {days} days.

CARDS.NO_SAMPLES: no conversation measured in the period
CARDS.BACKLOG_HELPER: {waiting} waiting for support · {overdue} past the SLA

TIPS.CSAT: Ratings 4 and 5 over every satisfaction answer in the period.
TIPS.ACCEPTANCE: Accepted invites over offered ones. Expired and declined count against the agent, even when the same conversation comes back to them.
TIPS.QUEUE: Open conversations with no assignee right now, in any channel.
TIPS.ONLINE: Agents with a live connection now (tab open), whatever their status.
TIPS.TIMES: Average of the times recorded in the period, grouped by the inbox's work channel. The value in parentheses discounts what fell outside business hours.
TIPS.ONLINE_TIME: Among agents with any online time in the period, the average time per worked day in statuses marked as counting online time.
TIPS.CREATED: Conversations that came in during the period, in any channel.
TIPS.RESOLVED: Resolutions recorded in the period (a conversation reopened and resolved again counts twice).
TIPS.BACKLOG: The real queue, no date cut: everything open, pending or snoozed right now. 'Waiting for support' is what is open; 'past the SLA' is what already missed the deadline.
TIPS.REOPENED: Conversations that went from resolved back to open in the period.
TIPS.FCR: Of the ones resolved in the period, how many were resolved with a single agent reply and no reopening.
TIPS.SLA: Of the conversations with a deadline that were answered in the period, how many were answered in time.

REALTIME.TITLE: Real time · agents
REALTIME.SUBTITLE: Status, connection and load of each agent right now. Refreshes every 15 seconds; not affected by the filters.
